note: T-UI-02b. Every illustration and character, by id. status: placeholder | final. A final asset needs a file, a source and a commercial licence (test). Placeholders are drawn in code as a soft tinted shape. Decorative art has no alt text and is hidden from screen readers. T-AVT-08b: the 7 cartoon characters are replaced by the 8 ready-made 3D coaches (coach_*), whose frame sets live in assets/avatar/frames/coaches/.
